text:
Hannah: hey team :wave: IT just handed me a Fedora laptop (Fedora 36) and I'm hitting some weird issues bootstrapping my dev environment. trying asdf for ruby and python but builds fail on openssl link. also can't clone the private dotfiles repo via Okta SSO 11 blank page. who's the right person to ping for each problem?
Matt: welcome @Hannah! quick checklist: which asdf plugins are you using and paste the exact asdf commands + error snippet. cc @Sree for package deps.
Hannah: `asdf plugin list` shows ruby, python, nodejs. running `asdf install ruby 3.1.2` and `asdf install python 3.11.4`. error during compile: ```
compiling openssl
ld: cannot find -lcrypto
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
make: *** [link_open] Error 1
```
Hannah: system `openssl version` -> "OpenSSL 1.1.1k 25 Mar 2021".
Sree: on Fedora that usually means you need the -devel packages and sometimes pkg-config paths. run: `sudo dnf install -y openssl-devel zlib-devel bzip2-devel libffi-devel xz-devel gcc make pkgconfig`
Sree: if you still see linker errors, export these before installing: ```
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/usr/lib64/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib64/pkgconfig"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/lib64:/usr/lib64"
export OPENSSL_DIR="/usr"
```
Sree: for ruby specifically try: `RUBY_CONFIGURE_OPTS=\"--with-openssl-dir=$OPENSSL_DIR\" asdf install ruby 3.1.2`
Omar: for the Okta/git issue, our SSO flow sometimes blocks headless auth windows. first try cloning while signed into Okta in Firefox/Chrome. if that doesn't work, open an IT ticket to add you to the engineering Okta group or ask People Ops for a repo-clone temporary waiver.
Matt: also remember to add your SSH key to the web UI after SSO succeeds. standard Fedora bootstrap commands we share: ```
# system updates + essentials
sudo dnf update -y
sudo dnf install -y git curl openssh-clients gnupg2 pass
# build deps often needed for asdf language builds
sudo dnf install -y bison libyaml-devel libffi-devel readline-devel xz-devel zlib-devel openssl-devel pkgconfig gcc make
```
Matt: enable direnv in your shell if your dotfiles use it: add `eval \"$(direnv hook bash)\"` (or fish/zsh equivalent) to your rc.
Hannah: did the dnf installs + exports, re-ran asdf, ruby build succeeded! python succeeded after adding xz-devel. thanks :tada:
Hannah: still stuck on Okta though 11 clicking the repo link just yields a blank Okta page (no error code).
Omar: if it's a blank page, grab the network tab from the browser devtools and paste a screenshot to IT. you can also request someone on the team to temporarily add your public key to the repo so you can finish dotfiles setup.
Matt: if you want I can submit the People Ops request (they usually respond within the day). also run `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and set `git config --global user.signingkey <your-gpg-key>` if you plan to sign commits.
deploy-bot: device registration detected for hannah-laptop (asset id HN-2345) - if this isn't you, file a ticket.
Hannah: ok IT created the ticket and Matt offered to add my key while they sort the SSO. I'm unblocked for now, ruby + python working and direnv hooked. huge thanks everyone :pray: will post if anything else pops up.
